trajectory.source: scripted: 60 still frames (gaussian sigma 0.004 palm units) then 60 frames at 0.15 palm units/s

metric_notes.still_jitter_rms_counts: RMS emitted counts while still: lower is steadier
metric_notes.still_peak_counts: largest single-frame count while still: worst visible twitch
metric_notes.ramp_median_counts: median counts per frame during constant-velocity motion
metric_notes.ramp_lag_vs_raw_counts: mean counts the variant trails raw by during the ramp
metric_notes.total_counts: sum over the path: a filter must not lose or invent travel

caveat: Scripted path, fixed parameters. Evidence for the Stage 3 exit criterion only: it does not establish feel on a real hand, and the shipped default remains the speed-adaptive One Euro filter.
